digest.component_or_area: eval-spec strict validation / Prompt Eval CI gate
propositions: Strict eval-spec validation runs only as an inline Python step in the non-gating Prompt Eval workflow, so it does not block the Gerrit Verified vote.
No unit test covers glob-based strict validation; test_new_eval_specs.py checks only a hardcoded 3-spec tuple, leaving new specs unchecked.
Three advisory plan-review specs shipped datasets without gold_set and merged green because the defect only reddened a non-gating workflow.
A glob-based unit test should be added to test_eval_scorers.py asserting validate_eval_spec is clean and strict validation passes for every dataset-bearing packaged spec.
The redundant inline validation step should be removed from prompt-eval.yml with no production code changes.
The new test must fail when a dataset-bearing spec lacks a gold_set and pass on current main.
